verdict.rationale: Omnara documents action-level approval gating and agents that can pause to ask questions. That is an adjacent control, not a documented capability for reviewing and approving an implementation plan before any code changes. The evidence describes no plan mode, spec or plan artifact, or plan-approval workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review and approve an agent's implementation plan before any code changes are made

citations.quote: You can decide which actions need approval, and agents can pause to ask questions when they need your input.
